_what: Archetype Gojira X after the Nameless Grind preset: the QC 1A Graft amp, EQ, cab level and reverb, with Gojira's own gate and OD off (the gate and the Grind live in Nameless). EQ bands and output are the values re-fitted on the measured take, not the QC's. Template: the plugin's factory Default.xml. The custom IR is not in this file: load it on the selected cab slot in the plugin window and press SAVE, or pass the three IR keys with --set (see references/preset-file-format.md).
name: Graft with Nameless Grind
